summary: The compliance review of the FlexLine: Revolving Credit Line App identified several non-compliance issues with the reviewed RBI rules. The product feature related to grievance redressal does not include named officers or contact details in the KFS, violating DLD2025:11(ii). The feature prohibiting email/SMS delivery of documents contradicts the requirement for digitally signed documents to be sent automatically via verified channels, as per DLD2025:8(iii). Additionally, the continuous location tracking feature for fraud prevention does not meet the need-based data collection and explicit consent requirements outlined in DLD2025:12(i). These findings highlight critical gaps in the product's compliance with RBI regulations.
